metadata: Recorded Crossref and official ICML 2025 citation fixtures; isolated disposable database
checks: release XPI is installed and active
plugin loaded from the actual XPI
registered chrome document loaded
review window has the required system principal
window title is set
heading has visible layout
real Zotero item clone produces an update preview
field differences rendered in Gecko
selecting a row enables update
update saved in the real Zotero database
published fields are correct
identity, child note and authors are retained
undo restores the real item
single-field update succeeds without changing item type
unchecked type, archive ID and URL stay unchanged
reported ICML paper produces a real Zotero preview
each reported field and recovered metadata has its own checkbox
checking a field selects its paper for update
selective conference update saved successfully
only conference name changes; manual publisher and proceedings title survive
saved changes table includes only the checked field
undo restores the selectively updated conference
additional publisher fields save through Zotero’s actual field registry
official ISSN and conference location fill the reported blanks
no DOI, ISBN or publisher location is fabricated
missing DOI is explained separately from lookup status
review window reopens after closing
disable unregisters chrome resources
disable/re-enable registers a working window again
